note: Cold D-1 limit-up reason attribution. date describes the pool trade date. One row per available pool member; expected_basis=pool_members and expected_count is the yesterday pool size. Reason source order: saved Kaipan getHisBans row, Kaipan getBanReasons st=200, WenCai 涨停原因类别, then last Type=0 reason dated before the described trade date (DEGRADED/HISTORICAL_ATTRIBUTION). Reasons dated after date are never used.

event_date.note: date of selected reason; must not exceed date

main_reason.note: one selected reason category; unknown is explicit

plate_code.note: unique main plate code: PZSCode else first ZSCode

plate_codes.note: source-provided board codes: all detailed ZSCode values, or saved pool row's single code

parent_plate_code.all_null_reason: Kaipan PZSCode is absent or zero for the observed reasons

plate_member_match.all_null_reason: dated plate_members input may be unavailable
